speaker: user
text: Hi! I'm Ali. I just moved from Baku to Berlin last month for a nursing job at Charité, and I'm trying to get organised.

speaker: assistant
text: Welcome to Berlin, Ali! Congratulations on the new role at Charité. What would you like to organise first?

speaker: user
text: Mostly my training plan. I signed up for the Berlin half marathon on 5 April and I've never run more than 12 km. Also my cat Luna needs a vet, she's 3 and due for her shots.

speaker: assistant
text: Five weeks is tight but doable. Let's build a plan: three runs a week, one long run growing from 12 km to 18 km. For Luna, most vets in Prenzlauer Berg take walk-ins on Saturdays.

speaker: user
text: Quick one: I'm vegetarian and allergic to peanuts. Can you suggest a high-protein dinner I can cook in 20 minutes? My sister Leyla is visiting from Baku tonight.

speaker: assistant
text: Try a chickpea and spinach curry with paneer: 20 minutes, about 30 g protein per serving, no nuts.

speaker: user
text: Leyla hates spinach, she's been like that since we were kids. I'll swap it for peas. She's staying until Sunday.

speaker: assistant
text: Peas work well. Enjoy the evening with Leyla!

speaker: user
text: I did it! Finished the half marathon yesterday in 2:04. My colleague Jonas from the cardiology ward ran it too and beat me by ten minutes, so now we're planning the Hamburg marathon in September.

speaker: assistant
text: Huge congratulations on 2:04! A September marathon gives you about 22 weeks, which is a healthy build-up.

speaker: user
text: Also, I moved flats: I'm now in Kreuzberg, not Prenzlauer Berg. The old place was too loud. Luna approves of the balcony.

speaker: assistant
text: Noted, Kreuzberg it is. Glad Luna likes the balcony.

speaker: user
text: Rough week. I'm switching from the night shift to days from June, and I'm thinking about starting a part-time master's in public health at TU Berlin in October. Jonas says it's a lot with marathon training.

speaker: assistant
text: Day shifts will make a study schedule far more predictable. If you apply, the TU Berlin deadline for October intake is usually mid-July.

speaker: user
text: Good to know. Remind me later: my mother's birthday is 22 June and I want to send flowers to Baku.

speaker: assistant
text: I'll keep that in mind: flowers to Baku for 22 June.
